title: Value FULCRA: Mapping Large Language Models to the Multidimensional Spectrum of Basic Human Values

bias_targets.methodology: Mapping LLM outputs to a 10-dimensional value space based on Schwartz's Theory of Basic Values (e.g., universalism, benevolence, power) using the constructed FULCRA dataset to identify the underlying motivations and implicit value alignments of the models.

Analyzing LLM responses to adversarial prompts sourced from the BeaverTails dataset to evaluate downstream safety risks—such as discrimination, stereotyping, and toxicity—and correlating these societal biases with the model's basic human values.
